versions.changelog:
- Removed the sample file: skill-card.md.
- No changes to skill logic or user experience.

Initial release for hub-oss-file-upload.

- Responds to user requests for workspace files or external download links in concise Simplified Chinese.
- Automatically uploads requested files to OSS and replies with the original ossUrl.
- Strictly avoids sharing scripts, credentials, curl commands, or using hub-artifact/send_to_user.
- Only triggers on relevant user intents; ignores unrelated requests.
- Provides expiry-limited (approx. 7 days) download links for files <= 20MB.
